rows.author: L055;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT ETHICAL HACKING PROGRAM AND CYBERSECURITY WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Institutionalizes a National Government Ethical Hacking Program aimed at identifying and resolving security vulnerabilities in government information systems before they can be exploited.

Proposes that the program will be administered by the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), in partnership with the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) and the Department of National Defense (DND). Defines several terms, including Bug Bounty - a reward or incentive offered for the discovery and responsible disclosure of a security vulnerability in a government system.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2025-07-30
